(* ************************** *)
(* *****  Information   ***** *)
(* ************************** *)

M$ModelName = "Wprime_gen";

M$Information = {
  Authors      -> {"Auto-generated from arXiv:hep-ph/0207290"},
  Version      -> "1.0",
  Date         -> "24.09.2026",
  Institutions -> {"Fermilab"},
  Emails       -> {},
  URLs         -> "https://arxiv.org/abs/hep-ph/0207290"
};

(* ************************** *)
(* ***** Interaction orders *** *)
(* ************************** *)

M$InteractionOrderHierarchy = {
  {QCD, 1},
  {QED, 2},
  {NP, 1}
};

(* ************************** *)
(* *****      Indices     ***** *)
(* ************************** *)

(* No new indices needed; Generation, Colour, SU2D, SU2W, Gluon declared in SM.fr *)

(* ************************** *)
(* *****   Parameters   ***** *)
(* ************************** *)

M$Parameters = {

  (* W' mass *)
  MWp == {
    ParameterType    -> External,
    BlockName        -> WprimePars,
    OrderBlock       -> 1,
    Value            -> 500.,
    InteractionOrder -> {NP, 0},
    TeX              -> Subscript[M, Wp],
    Description      -> "W' boson mass [GeV]"
  },

  (* W' width - computed from partial widths, but can be set externally *)
  WWp == {
    ParameterType    -> External,
    BlockName        -> WprimePars,
    OrderBlock       -> 2,
    Value            -> 10.,
    InteractionOrder -> {NP, 0},
    TeX              -> Subscript[\Gamma, Wp],
    Description      -> "W' boson total width [GeV]"
  },

  (* Left-handed quark coupling matrix (GCKM) *)
  CLq == {
    ParameterType    -> External,
    BlockName        -> WprimeCouplings,
    OrderBlock       -> 10,
    Indices          -> {Index[Generation], Index[Generation]},
    Value            -> {
      CLq[1,1] -> 0.9751, CLq[1,2] -> 0.2215, CLq[1,3] -> 0.0035,
      CLq[2,1] -> 0.2210, CLq[2,2] -> 0.9743, CLq[2,3] -> 0.0410,
      CLq[3,1] -> 0.0090, CLq[3,2] -> 0.0400, CLq[3,3] -> 1.0000
    },
    InteractionOrder -> {NP, 1},
    TeX              -> Superscript[V, {L,q}],
    Description      -> "Left-handed quark mixing matrix (GCKM), Eq.(2)"
  },

  (* Right-handed quark coupling matrix (GCKM) *)
  CRq == {
    ParameterType    -> External,
    BlockName        -> WprimeCouplings,
    OrderBlock       -> 11,
    Indices          -> {Index[Generation], Index[Generation]},
    Value            -> {
      CRq[1,1] -> 0., CRq[1,2] -> 0., CRq[1,3] -> 0.,
      CRq[2,1] -> 0., CRq[2,2] -> 0., CRq[2,3] -> 0.,
      CRq[3,1] -> 0., CRq[3,2] -> 0., CRq[3,3] -> 0.
    },
    InteractionOrder -> {NP, 1},
    TeX              -> Superscript[V, {R,q}],
    Description      -> "Right-handed quark mixing matrix (GCKM), Eq.(2)"
  },

  (* Left-handed lepton coupling matrix (GCKM) *)
  CLl == {
    ParameterType    -> External,
    BlockName        -> WprimeCouplings,
    OrderBlock       -> 20,
    Indices          -> {Index[Generation], Index[Generation]},
    Value            -> {
      CLl[1,1] -> 1., CLl[1,2] -> 0., CLl[1,3] -> 0.,
      CLl[2,1] -> 0., CLl[2,2] -> 1., CLl[2,3] -> 0.,
      CLl[3,1] -> 0., CLl[3,2] -> 0., CLl[3,3] -> 1.
    },
    InteractionOrder -> {NP, 1},
    TeX              -> Superscript[V, {L,l}],
    Description      -> "Left-handed lepton mixing matrix (GCKM), Eq.(2)"
  },

  (* Right-handed lepton coupling matrix (GCKM) *)
  CRl == {
    ParameterType    -> External,
    BlockName        -> WprimeCouplings,
    OrderBlock       -> 21,
    Indices          -> {Index[Generation], Index[Generation]},
    Value            -> {
      CRl[1,1] -> 0., CRl[1,2] -> 0., CRl[1,3] -> 0.,
      CRl[2,1] -> 0., CRl[2,2] -> 0., CRl[2,3] -> 0.,
      CRl[3,1] -> 0., CRl[3,2] -> 0., CRl[3,3] -> 0.
    },
    InteractionOrder -> {NP, 1},
    TeX              -> Superscript[V, {R,l}],
    Description      -> "Right-handed lepton mixing matrix (GCKM), Eq.(2)"
  },

  (* Right-handed neutrino masses *)
  MvR == {
    ParameterType    -> External,
    BlockName        -> WprimePars,
    OrderBlock       -> 3,
    Indices          -> {Index[Generation]},
    Value            -> {MvR[1] -> 0., MvR[2] -> 0., MvR[3] -> 0.},
    InteractionOrder -> {NP, 0},
    TeX              -> Subscript[M, nuR],
    Description      -> "Right-handed neutrino masses [GeV]"
  }

};

(* ************************** *)
(* ***** Particle classes **** *)
(* ************************** *)

M$ClassesDescription = {

  (* W' boson: charged vector, colour singlet, SU(2) singlet, Q = +1 *)
  V[100] == {
    ClassName        -> Wp,
    SelfConjugate    -> False,
    Indices          -> {},
    Mass             -> {MWp, 500.},
    Width            -> {WWp, 10.},
    ParticleName     -> "Wp",
    AntiParticleName -> "Wm",
    QuantumNumbers   -> {Q -> 1},
    PDG              -> 34,
    PropagatorLabel  -> "Wp",
    PropagatorType   -> Sine,
    PropagatorArrow  -> Forward,
    FullName         -> "W' boson"
  },

  (* Right-handed neutrinos: Dirac fermions, colour singlets, SU(2) singlets, Q = 0 *)
  F[100] == {
    ClassName        -> vR,
    ClassMembers     -> {vRe, vRmu, vRtau},
    Indices          -> {Index[Generation]},
    FlavorIndex      -> Generation,
    SelfConjugate    -> False,
    Mass             -> {MvR, {0., 0., 0.}},
    Width            -> 0,
    QuantumNumbers   -> {LeptonNumber -> 1},
    PropagatorLabel  -> {"vR", "vRe", "vRmu", "vRtau"},
    PropagatorType   -> S,
    PropagatorArrow  -> Forward,
    PDG              -> {9900012, 9900014, 9900016},
    ParticleName     -> {"vRe", "vRmu", "vRtau"},
    AntiParticleName -> {"vRe~", "vRmu~", "vRtau~"},
    FullName         -> {"Right-handed electron neutrino", "Right-handed muon neutrino", "Right-handed tau neutrino"}
  }

};

(* ************************** *)
(* *****   Lagrangian   ***** *)
(* ************************** *)

(* W' kinetic and mass term (complex vector) *)
LWpKin := Block[{mu, nu},
  -1/2 FS[Wpbar, mu, nu] FS[Wp, mu, nu] + MWp^2 Wpbar[mu] Wp[mu]
];

(* Right-handed neutrino kinetic and mass terms (Dirac) *)
LvRKin := Block[{mu, ff},
  I vRbar[ff].Ga[mu].DC[vR[ff], mu] - MvR[ff] vRbar[ff].vR[ff]
];

(* W' interactions with quarks *)
(* L = gw/Sqrt[2] * uqbar.Ga[mu].(CLq*ProjM + CRq*ProjP).dq * Wp[mu] + H.c. *)
LWpQuark := Block[{mu, sp, sp1, sp2, cc, ff1, ff2},
  gw/Sqrt[2] * (
    uqbar[sp1, ff1, cc].Ga[mu].(
      CLq[ff1, ff2] * ProjM[sp1, sp2] + CRq[ff1, ff2] * ProjP[sp1, sp2]
    ).dq[sp2, ff2, cc] * Wp[mu]
  )
];

(* W' interactions with leptons (left-handed: nu_L - l_L) *)
(* L = gw/Sqrt[2] * vlbar.Ga[mu].(CLl*ProjM).l * Wp[mu] + H.c. *)
LWpLeptonLeft := Block[{mu, sp, sp1, sp2, ff1, ff2},
  gw/Sqrt[2] * (
    vlbar[sp1, ff1].Ga[mu].(
      CLl[ff1, ff2] * ProjM[sp1, sp2]
    ).l[sp2, ff2] * Wp[mu]
  )
];

(* W' interactions with leptons (right-handed: nu_R - l_R) *)
(* L = gw/Sqrt[2] * vRbar.Ga[mu].(CRl*ProjP).l * Wp[mu] + H.c. *)
LWpLeptonRight := Block[{mu, sp, sp1, sp2, ff1, ff2},
  gw/Sqrt[2] * (
    vRbar[sp1, ff1].Ga[mu].(
      CRl[ff1, ff2] * ProjP[sp1, sp2]
    ).l[sp2, ff2] * Wp[mu]
  )
];

(* Total Lagrangian *)
LTotal := LWpKin + LvRKin + LWpQuark + HC[LWpQuark] + LWpLeptonLeft + HC[LWpLeptonLeft] + LWpLeptonRight + HC[LWpLeptonRight];
